login.passwordLabel.description: Label of the password field on the sign-in screen.

login.submit.description: Main button of the password form on the sign-in screen.

login.forgot.description: Button-shaped link under the password form on the sign-in screen: opens the reset-password view.

login.withEmailCode.text: Sign in with an email code
login.withEmailCode.description: Button-shaped link under the password form on the sign-in screen: switches to signing in with a 6-digit code sent by email.

login.resetDone.title.description: Title of the green confirmation box on the sign-in screen after a password reset succeeded.

login.resetDone.body.text: For security, you’ve been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
login.resetDone.body.description: Body of the green confirmation box on the sign-in screen after a password reset succeeded. "Everywhere" means on every device.

login.otp.title.description: Heading of the sign-in screen on the step that asks for an email address to send a code to.

login.otp.titleCode.description: Heading of the sign-in screen on the step that asks for the emailed 6-digit code.

login.otp.lead.text: We'll email you a 6-digit code to sign in. New here? You'll get an account and a place on the waitlist.
login.otp.lead.description: Paragraph on the email-code step of the sign-in screen, above the email field.

login.otp.emailLabel.description: Label of the email address field on the email-code step of the sign-in screen.

login.otp.emailPlaceholder.description: Example email address shown as the placeholder of the email field on the email-code step of the sign-in screen. Keep it a valid-looking address at example.com.

login.otp.request.description: Button on the email-code step of the sign-in screen: emails a 6-digit sign-in code to the address typed.

login.otp.requestIn_one.description: The Email me a code button while it is disabled: counts down the seconds until another code may be asked for. {{count}} is seconds; "s" abbreviates seconds.

login.otp.requestIn_other.description: The Email me a code button while it is disabled: counts down the seconds until another code may be asked for. {{count}} is seconds; "s" abbreviates seconds.

login.otp.sending.description: Status on the email-code step of the sign-in screen while the email with the code is being sent.

login.otp.sent.text: We sent you a code. It expires in 10 minutes.
login.otp.sent.description: Status on the sign-in screen after the email with the 6-digit code was sent.

login.otp.emailInvalid.description: Error on the email-code step of the sign-in screen when the email field is empty or has no @.

login.otp.tooMany.text: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
login.otp.tooMany.description: Error on the email-code step of the sign-in screen when too many codes were asked for in a short time and the server gave no message of its own.

login.otp.sendFailed.description: Error on the email-code step of the sign-in screen when the email could not be sent and the server gave no reason of its own.

login.otp.codeLead.text: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to <0>{{email}}</0>.
login.otp.codeLead.description: Paragraph above the code field on the sign-in screen. {{email}} is the address the code was sent to, drawn stronger inside <0></0>.

login.otp.codeLabel.description: Label of the field for the emailed code on the sign-in screen.

login.otp.verify.description: Button under the code field on the sign-in screen: checks the emailed code. Verify is a verb.

login.otp.verifying.description: Status on the sign-in screen while the emailed code is being checked.

login.otp.resend.description: Button under Verify code on the sign-in screen: emails another code to the same address.

login.otp.resendIn_one.description: The Send a new code button while it is disabled: counts down the seconds until another code may be asked for. {{count}} is seconds; "s" abbreviates seconds.

login.otp.resendIn_other.description: The Send a new code button while it is disabled: counts down the seconds until another code may be asked for. {{count}} is seconds; "s" abbreviates seconds.

login.otp.codeMissing.text: Enter the code from the email
login.otp.codeMissing.description: Error on the sign-in screen when Verify code was pressed with the code field empty.

login.otp.tooManyAttempts.text: Too many code attempts. Try again shortly.
login.otp.tooManyAttempts.description: Error on the sign-in screen when wrong codes were entered too many times and the server gave no message of its own.

login.otp.codeRejected.description: Error on the sign-in screen when the emailed code was refused and the server gave no reason of its own.

login.otp.backToPassword.description: Button at the foot of the email step of the sign-in screen: returns to the username and password form.

login.otp.backWrongAddress.description: Button at the foot of the code step of the sign-in screen: returns to the email step to correct the address.

login.otp.backToLogin.description: Button at the foot of the choose-a-password step of the sign-in screen: returns to the username and password form.

login.signup.intro.text: Code verified. Now choose a password for your account.
login.signup.intro.description: Paragraph on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password, for an existing account that has a username.

login.signup.introNew.text: Code verified. No account uses this email yet, so we'll create one. Choose a username and a password.
login.signup.introNew.description: Paragraph on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password, when the email address is new and an account is being created.

login.signup.introUsername.text: Code verified. Choose a username and a password for your account.
login.signup.introUsername.description: Paragraph on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password, for an existing account that still has no username.

login.signup.usernameLabel.description: Label of the username field on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password and a username.

login.signup.usernamePlaceholder.description: Example username shown as the placeholder of the username field when making an account with an email code. One lower-case word without spaces.

login.signup.usernamePublic.text: Your username will be public to other users on Homeroom.
login.signup.usernamePublic.description: Note under the username field when making an account with an email code. Homeroom is the product's name.

login.signup.usernameRule.text: Letters, numbers and underscores, 3 to 32 characters.
login.signup.usernameRule.description: Hint under the username field when making an account with an email code: what a username may contain and how long it may be.

login.signup.passwordLabel.description: Label of the password field on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password.

login.signup.passwordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the New password field on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password. Lower case in English on purpose.

login.signup.confirmLabel.description: Label of the field where the new password is typed a second time, on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password. Confirm is a verb.

login.signup.confirmPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Confirm password field on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password. Lower case in English on purpose.

login.signup.waitlistNote.text: New accounts get a spot on the waitlist. We’re letting people in a few at a time.
login.signup.waitlistNote.description: Note above the button on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password, shown when the new account will not have access yet.

login.signup.submitNew.description: Button on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password, when a new account is being created.

login.signup.submit.description: Button on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password, when the account already exists and only gets a password.

login.signup.saving.description: Status on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password while the password is being saved.

login.signup.usernameMissing.description: Error under the username field when making an account with an email code and the field is empty.

login.signup.passwordTooShort.text: Password must be at least 8 characters
login.signup.passwordTooShort.description: Error on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password when the password typed is shorter than 8 characters.

login.signup.passwordMismatch.description: Error on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password when the two password fields differ.

login.signup.failed.description: Error on the last step of signing in with an email code, where the person chooses a password when the server refused and gave no reason of its own.

login.recovery.title.description: Heading of the reset-password view of the sign-in screen.

login.recovery.back.description: Link at the foot of the reset-password view: returns to the username and password form.

login.recovery.noEmailOnFile.text: Accounts here have no email on file, so a password can't be reset automatically from the web.
login.recovery.noEmailOnFile.description: Paragraph on the reset-password view when this Homeroom installation cannot send reset emails.

login.recovery.unconfirmedWarning.text: If you did not confirm your email account, you will not receive the reset email.
login.recovery.unconfirmedWarning.description: First line of the warning box on the reset-password view.

login.recovery.askSupport.text: If this happens to you, ask Homeroom support team to issue you a temporary password (support@usernodelabs.org).
login.recovery.askSupport.description: Second line of the warning box on the reset-password view. Homeroom is the product's name; keep the email address as it is.

login.recovery.askAdmin.text: Ask a Homeroom platform admin to issue you a <0>temporary password</0>. Once you're back in, set a password you choose from <1>Settings → Change password</1>.
login.recovery.askAdmin.description: Paragraph on the reset-password view when reset emails are not available. <0></0> is emphasis; <1></1> is a link to the Change password page of Settings, written as a path with an arrow. Homeroom is the product's name.

login.walletReset.lead.text: Your wallet is linked to this account. Approve a signature request, then choose a new password.
login.walletReset.lead.description: Paragraph on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet. The signature request appears in the person's wallet.

login.walletReset.passwordLabel.description: Label of the new password field on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet.

login.walletReset.passwordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the New password field on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet. Lower case in English on purpose.

login.walletReset.confirmLabel.description: Label of the field where the new password is typed a second time, on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet. Confirm is a verb.

login.walletReset.confirmPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Confirm new password field on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet. Lower case in English on purpose.

login.walletReset.submit.description: Button on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet: asks the wallet for a signature and, if it is approved, saves the new password.

login.walletReset.verifying.description: Status on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet while the wallet's signature is being requested and checked.

login.walletReset.passwordTooShort.text: Password must be at least 8 characters
login.walletReset.passwordTooShort.description: Error on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet when the new password is shorter than 8 characters.

login.walletReset.passwordMismatch.description: Error on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet when the two password fields differ.

login.walletReset.noChallenge.text: Could not get a challenge from the server
login.walletReset.noChallenge.description: Error on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet when the server did not send the text the wallet has to sign.

login.walletReset.failed.description: Error on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet when the server refused the reset and gave no reason of its own.

login.walletReset.denied.description: Error on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet when the person declined the signature request in their wallet.

login.walletReset.failedReason.description: Error on the reset-password view for an account with a linked crypto wallet when the reset failed for another reason. {{reason}} is the technical message from the wallet, shown as it came.

login.emailReset.lead.text: Enter the email address on your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
login.emailReset.lead.description: Paragraph on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link.

login.emailReset.label.description: Label of the email address field on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link.

login.emailReset.placeholder.description: Example email address shown as the placeholder of the email field on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link. Keep it a valid-looking address at example.com.

login.emailReset.submit.description: Button on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link: emails a link for choosing a new password.

login.emailReset.sent.text: If that address matches an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.
login.emailReset.sent.description: Green confirmation on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link after the button was pressed. Worded so it does not reveal whether an account uses the address.

login.emailReset.emailMissing.text: Enter the email address on your account
login.emailReset.emailMissing.description: Error on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link when the email field is empty or not an address.

login.emailReset.sendFailed.text: Could not send the link. Try again in a minute
login.emailReset.sendFailed.description: Error on the reset-password view, in the part that emails a reset link when the reset email could not be sent and the server gave no reason of its own.

login.reset.title.description: Heading on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen.

login.reset.passwordLabel.description: Label of the new password field on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen.

login.reset.passwordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the New password field on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen. Lower case in English on purpose.

login.reset.confirmLabel.description: Label of the field where the new password is typed a second time, on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen. Confirm is a verb.

login.reset.confirmPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Confirm new password field on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen. Lower case in English on purpose.

login.reset.submit.description: Main button on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen: saves the new password.

login.reset.back.description: Button under the form on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen: returns to the sign-in form without changing the password.

login.reset.expired.text: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Go back to login and request a new one from "Forgot password?".
login.reset.expired.description: Error on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen, when the link that opened it can no longer be used. The quoted words are the label of the Forgot password? link on the sign-in screen and must match its translation.

login.reset.passwordTooShort.text: Password must be at least 8 characters
login.reset.passwordTooShort.description: Error on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen, when the new password is shorter than 8 characters.

login.reset.passwordMismatch.description: Error on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen, when the two password fields differ.

login.reset.failed.description: Error on the screen opened from a password-reset email, where a new password is chosen, when the server refused the new password and gave no reason of its own.

signInSheet.account.welcome.description: Title of the sign-in sheet on the last step of making an account, in place of "Finish your account", when the person arrived by the link in the email saying they were let in from the waitlist and that link signed them in. {{email}} is their email address.

signInSheet.account.skip.description: Button under Continue on the "Finish your account" step of the sign-in sheet: finishes without setting a password. The person then signs in with an emailed code and can add a password in Settings later.

login.signup.finishing.description: Status on the last step of signing in with an email code while the account is being finished without a password (the person skipped it or left both password fields empty).

login.signup.skip.description: Button under the main button on the last step of signing in with an email code: finishes without setting a password. The person then signs in with an emailed code and can add a password in Settings later.
